QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_18

question.text: Can investors buy mutual fund units using mobile phone apps?

answer.text: Yes — mobile and web-based applications facilitate mutual fund transactions
No — mutual funds can only be bought through physical forms
No — mobile apps are only for checking NAV, not for transactions
Yes — but only for investments above Rs. 1 lakh

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, mutual fund distribution takes place through electronic platforms, mobile phones, distributor apps, AMC mobile/web applications, SMS/WhatsApp facilities and new-age investment apps. Investors can transact in mutual funds through these channels. The Trap: Physical forms are not the only method any more. The other distractors invent restrictions (NAV-only or a minimum investment threshold) that are not part of the source. Note: The workbook does not state that mobile is the most popular channel, nor does it set a minimum amount restriction for mobile transactions.
